# Carnegie Learning

> > Carnegie Learning provides AI-powered math and world language curricula including MATHia, ClearMath Elementary, Texas Math Solution, and culturally immersive language programs.

Carnegie Learning is an educational technology company based in Pittsburgh offering comprehensive K-12 solutions for mathematics and world languages. Their flagship products include the adaptive MATHia platform, Teacher's Toolkit, Clear Learning Center (MyCL), and language programs for Spanish, French, and German with specialized curricula like ¡Qué chévere! and T'es branché?.

## Key Topics

- MATHia (adaptive math learning platform)
- ClearMath Elementary (K-5 curriculum)
- Texas Math Solution (TEKS-aligned)
- Teacher's Toolkit (instructional resources)
- Clear Learning Center / MyCL (learning management)
- World Languages (Spanish, French, German)
- CLEAR Math (comprehensive curriculum)
- Lenses on Literature (literacy)
- Content preferences and teacher setup
- Assessment and reporting tools
- Course Report and Standards Report
- CSV export and admin reporting
- Culturally responsive instruction
- Blended learning approaches

## Math Curriculum Solutions

- [Explore Georgia Math Solutions](https://www.carnegielearning.com/samples/georgia-math-solution/explore): ClearMath K-12 curriculum aligned to Georgia Mathematics Standards
- [Mississippi Department of Education Adopts Carnegie Learning K-5 Math Curriculum](https://www.carnegielearning.com/company/press/mississippi-department-of-education-adopts-carnegie-learning-k-5-math-curriculum): Mississippi adopts ClearMath Elementary K-5 curriculum statewide
- [Assessment Guidance](https://www.carnegielearning.com/texas-help/article/assessment-guidance): TEKS-aligned assessment guidance for Texas Math Solution grades 6-8
- [Teacher Creativity Shines in Texas](https://www.carnegielearning.com/blog/success-spotlight-spring-isd-2): Spring ISD teachers showcase creativity with high-quality math materials

## World Language Programs

- [Explore ¡Qué chévere!](https://www.carnegielearning.com/samples/wl/que-chevere): 4-level Spanish curriculum for grades 6-12 with cultural immersion
- [T'es branché?](https://www.carnegielearning.com/solutions/world-languages/tes-branche): 4-level French curriculum for grades 6-12 with blended learning approach
- [Explore Destinations Library](https://www.carnegielearning.com/digital-review/destinations-library): Immersive language learning library for Spanish, French, and German

## Platform Setup and Configuration

- [Setting Your Content Preferences](https://www.carnegielearning.com/texas-help/article/setting-your-content-preferences): Configure MATHia and Teacher's Toolkit content preferences in MyCL
- [Setting Your Content Preferences (Getting Started)](https://www.carnegielearning.com/texas-help/article/setting-your-content-preferences-getting-started): Getting started guide for Teacher's Toolkit and MATHia setup
- [Understanding the Icons on the Class Details Page](https://www.carnegielearning.com/texas-help/article/understanding-the-icons-on-the-class-details-page): Guide to Class Details page icons in Teacher's Toolkit and MATHia
- [Closing an Assignment in Clear Learning Center](https://www.carnegielearning.com/texas-help/article/closing-an-assignment-in-clear-learning-center): How to close assignments and manage submissions in Clear Learning Center

## Teaching Strategies and Resources

- [Reading Strategies to Engage All Students](https://www.carnegielearning.com/texas-help/article/reading-strategies-to-engage-all-students): Culturally responsive reading strategies for emergent bilingual students
- [Grado 8](https://www.carnegielearning.com/texas-help/article/grado-8): Spanish-language Grade 8 math family guides and module resources

## Reporting and Data Export

- [Additional Exporting Capabilities Added to Admin Reports](https://www.carnegielearning.com/texas-help/article/additional-exporting-capabilities-added-to-admin-reports-txms): CSV export functionality for Texas Math Solution admin reports
